notes: v2.5.17 - required update. Finishing a build no longer finishes the whole project. The status control now names whichever thing you have selected, so you can see what you are about to complete before you complete it. A build you re-open no longer keeps its old completion date. On the Strategic Overview, a role now shows as held by the people who actually hold it, and roles and permission history have moved onto their own tabs so each one has room to be read. This release also updates the database behind AOS, so please update as soon as you are prompted.
